appearances: description: Dark-haired woman with extensive circular or spiral body tattoos/patterns.; source_refs: ['433_The_Metabarons_17_p06']

description: Shown restrained in a prison chamber on p03; undergoing biomechanical reintegration via spiked contact-point apparatus on p06.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03', '433_The_Metabarons_17_p06']
important_actions: action: Freed from Kgen-Kgen planetary prison by the whore-priestesses.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
action: Underwent biomechanical reintegration; declared herself restored and complete.; source_refs: ['433_The_Metabarons_17_p06']
action: Demonstrated swarm-division ability: split from one into two, then multiplied into many identical warrior-units while armored observers watched.; source_refs: ['434_The_Metabarons_17_p07']
action: Swarm copies (Zombras) deployed against Aghora in the Gardens of Flos; overwhelmed the Metabaron's rearguard defense.; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09']
knowledge_boundaries: The exact nature of what was restored inside her during reintegration is not shown explicitly on the pages.
Whether she retained awareness of or coordination with her swarm copies is not stated.
relationships: character: The Four Whore-Priestesses of Shabda-Oud; nature: Freed by them from Kgen-Kgen; calls one a 'double-voiced witch'; aware of their near-extermination by the Metabaron; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
traits: Defiant and openly hostile toward even her rescuers
Suspicious of others' motives; demands explanations
Experiences biomechanical reintegration as pleasurable and completing
Possesses power to divide into millions of identical humanoid warrior-units that can recombine into one body
Swarm-division is said to be capable of devastating an entire planet
voice_notes: Immediately demands to know why she is being rescued rather than accepting the act.
Calls one rescuer a 'double-voiced witch,' suggesting either a title, personal insult, or recognition of unusual speech.
Declares herself 'reborn and complete' after reintegration.
witnessed_facts: fact: Was held in a planetary-scale prison — dialogue states an entire planet was built specifically to contain her.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
fact: Learned that only four clan members survived after the Metabaron wiped out nearly the entire clan.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
fact: Underwent biomechanical reintegration using shadow rods and psycho-essence; reported an internal presence returning.; source_refs: ['433_The_Metabarons_17_p06']

fact: Her copies (Zombras) were unleashed in the Gardens of Flos by the whore-priestesses; all Zombras were incinerated when planet Flos was destroyed.; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09', '440_The_Metabarons_17_p14']
